history.event: Claude refinement: 54 line(s) suggested — Corrected garbled names and words from the entry formulas (larghi, lanaiuoli, alamanno de medici, chontanti), sums in words that match the sums column (cinque = ⫳ 5, uintotto = ⫳ 28), the florin sign read as ⫳/ai/R (ƒ due larghi, ƒ 2 la, ƒ uno la), and the date crosses read as ⫳/ta/E (now +). | layout: l4: marginal account number 77 lies at left, partly inside the box; l8: final glyph (lira sign + letter) sits at the right edge of the box; it may start the sum written in words that continues in l9; l9: the sum figure 1 (after ⫳) lies outside the box to the right; l21: marginal number 88 at left, outside the text; l28: marginal numbers 93 / 73 at left; l48: marginal number 85 at left; l49: marginal number 73 at left, inside the box; l50: the cross before the date line lies outside the box to the left; l52: marginal number 81 at left; l53: tiny box on the marginal number (85) beside l60's entry; it is a ledger cross-reference, not text in the column; l57: the sum ⫳ 10 for this entry is in the separate box l59; l60: the entry initial (A) lies outside the box to the left; l63: box lies in the gutter/facing page (a flourish of the next page's writing), not this page: probably delete | doubts: l1: the year's first figure is a large looped letter, taken as M (1466, Florentine style before April 1467); Kraken renders the opening cross as ⫳; the cross is given as + throughout (l2, l19, l26, l39, l46, l58), so please confirm how this manuscript should encode it; l4/l20: 'ꝙano' is the amount written in words before the sum ⫳ 4 (presumably quatro, abbreviated); the abbreviation form was left as Kraken has it; l5/l6: 'di4º crurola vinide' and the first word of l6 could not be read with confidence; l16: 'cinque' is inferred from the sum ⫳ 5 in l18; last word unclear; l28: first word unclear (lavalio? lavoratore?); l35/l36: the amount in l35 (ß uni?) and the iiiiº in l36 could not be confirmed against the sum 4.16; l40: vetturale's name unreadable; 'uintotto' inferred from the sum ⫳ 28; l47: first word (margherita?) unclear; 'ƒ uno la' read from the sign R + 'uno'; l62: the text says ß dodici but the sums column shows the same sign (⫳) before 12 as elsewhere; check whether the column sign here means soldi; l23/l24/l43/l45: several words (ꝓescrre, rerborre, charaste, tussi cnꝙe) left as Kraken has them because the image did not allow a sure reading
